query: Diagram the human cardiovascular system showing blood flow direction through the heart chambers, lungs, and major vessels.
narrative:
Here is a simple ASCII-style diagram showing **blood flow direction** through the **heart chambers, lungs, and major vessels**. Arrows (→) show flow direction; labels in parentheses indicate oxygen level.

```text
                      SYSTEMIC VEINS (from body)
               deoxygenated blood (low O₂ / high CO₂)
                    ↓                         ↓
         SUPERIOR VENA CAVA           INFERIOR VENA CAVA
                     \                 /
                      \               /
                       \             /
                        ↓           ↓
                        RIGHT ATRIUM (RA) – deoxygenated[4]
                                   |
                                   | through TRICUSPID VALVE[4]
                                   ↓
                        RIGHT VENTRICLE (RV) – deoxygenated[4]
                                   |
                                   | through PULMONARY VALVE[4]
                                   ↓
                         MAIN PULMONARY ARTERY (MPA)[4]
                                   |
                                   | splits into
                                   ↓
                    RIGHT & LEFT PULMONARY ARTERIES – to lungs[4][5]
                                   |
                                   | gas exchange in LUNGS
                                   | (blood picks up O₂, drops CO₂)[4][5]
                                   ↓
                    PULMONARY VEINS (4) – oxygenated blood[4][5]
                                   |
                                   ↓
                        LEFT ATRIUM (LA) – oxygenated[4]
                                   |
                                   | through MITRAL VALVE[4]
                                   ↓
                        LEFT VENTRICLE (LV) – oxygenated[4]
                                   |
                                   | through AORTIC VALVE[4]
                                   ↓
                               AORTA – main artery[1][4][5]
                                   |
                OXYGENATED BLOOD TO ALL BODY TISSUES (systemic circulation)[3][5]
                                   |
                                   | capillaries deliver O₂ / pick up CO₂
                                   ↓
                     SYSTEMIC VEINS → SVC & IVC → RIGHT ATRIUM[3][4]
```

---

### Text flow (step-by-step, matching the diagram)

**Pulmonary circulation (heart ↔ lungs)**[3][4][5]  
1. Body → **SVC/IVC** → **Right atrium** (deoxygenated)[3][4]  
2. Right atrium → **Tricuspid valve** → **Right ventricle**[3][4]  
3. Right ventricle → **Pulmonary valve** → **Pulmonary artery → lungs**[3][4]  
4. Lungs (gas exchange) → **Pulmonary veins** → **Left atrium** (now oxygenated)[3][4][5]  

**Systemic circulation (heart ↔ body)**[3][4][5]  
5. Left atrium → **Mitral valve** → **Left ventricle**[3][4]  
6. Left ventricle → **Aortic valve** → **Aorta → body**[1][3][4][5]  
7. Capillaries in tissues → **Systemic veins → SVC/IVC → Right atrium**[3][4]  

---

### Claims vs. evidence (with confidence)

1. **Blood pathway order:**  
   Body → SVC/IVC → RA → RV → pulmonary artery → lungs → pulmonary veins → LA → LV → aorta → body.[3][4]  
   - Confidence: **Very high** (standard anatomy; identical sequence across CDC, Cleveland Clinic, UCSF).

2. **Right heart handles deoxygenated blood to lungs; left heart handles oxygenated blood to body.**[2][3][4][5]  
   - Confidence: **Very high** (basic division of pulmonary vs systemic circulation, universally described).

3. **Flow is one-way, enforced by valves (tricuspid, pulmonary, mitral, aortic).**[3][4]  
   - Confidence: **Very high** (core function of cardiac valves in all references).

If you want, I can also provide a simplified version suitable for labeling on a worksheet, or a more detailed diagram including coronary arteries and capillary beds.
